label: At D1, fires after unrewarded S1 visits, strongest after a run of unrewarded trials.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("reward", -3) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_action == 2) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (prev_state == 1)
explanation: Active only at D1 (zero at GO/D2). Magnitude is driven by the last trial having reached S1 unrewarded, with a strong interaction with the trial before also being unrewarded (no reward on the last two trials while the last state was S1 gives about +0.84), plus a smaller boost for any three-trial run without reward. Any reward on the last trial silences it. The choice made (a1 vs a2) matters little once the reward streak is included, and belief_lo adds almost nothing. Reward sums == 0 encode no reward on those trials. The free fit adds a1-vs-a2 splits and the trial-before state and does only slightly better (test 0.50 vs 0.45 for the short form, 89%).

issues: The recorded short form reproduces at test R^2 beyond timing 0.447. The core claims also check out: the feature fires only at D1 (GO and D2 residuals are about 0), it needs the last trial to be an unrewarded S1 visit (that one term alone scores 0.220), and it is much stronger when the trial before was also unrewarded (that term plus the S1-unrewarded term score 0.438).

The explanation says the choice made (a1 vs a2) 'matters little' once the reward streak is in the fit. Misses on the recorded short form contradict this. The largest systematic errors are D1 after a1 S1 u, under-predicted by +0.145, and D1 after a2 S1 u, over-predicted by -0.112. The profile residuals agree: +0.556 after a1 S1 u against +0.223 after a2 S1 u. Splitting by choice with last_is gives weights of 1.23 for a1 S1 u and 0.54 for a2 S1 u, each with the trial before unrewarded. So an unrewarded common visit to S1 drives the feature about twice as hard as an unrewarded rare one. That split raises test R^2 to 0.475, and the a1/a2 errors in misses drop to +0.048 or less.
The run-of-three term (any state) adds little: 0.438 without it, 0.447 with it. A term that adds that little does not support the 'strongest after a run' wording beyond two unrewarded trials.
The belief claim holds: terms on belief_lo add nothing (0.442 when one replaces the run term, 0.248 for belief-based forms built on the unrewarded-S1 term).

Part of the error sits at the window edges. At the window's first trials, tv('reward', -2) is unknown (-9), and some of the worst misses are 3.0+ activations predicted near 0.2. Flagging that case gives only +0.01 (0.456), so this is a limit of the data, not of the label.
The concern about -1 penalties slipping through does not matter: writing the trial before as 'not rewarded' (!= 1) scores worse (0.437) than 'unrewarded' (== 0).
